name: holm teaching kitchen v2 exterior
review_note: Compound of gable, lean-to pantry, apse and flue now carries bargeboards and finials on both gables, louvred shutters with hinge pins on every window and a clay pot on the range flue; the family palette held at 30. Reads as a working bakehouse from the north lane.
improve: The apse roof courses are still flat slabs; the flue pot barely registers against the sky at gameplay distance; the gable end wants a datestone or hanging sign.
